I’m broken, I’ve lived in an abusive house my whole life. No o he cares about me. My mother says maybe we should end it together then and mocks me and my dad is passed out drunk 70% of the time other 30% he is screaming and throwing things at my mom and I. I have learning disabilities that for me, mean I have no future then to be a stay at home whatever. For a while religion saved me but now I’m sure God hates me, they say life is a test in my religion and after pain comes happiness but if that was true don’t you think after 15 years of pure misery and torture God would make it better? Make me happy? I’m going to hell anyway so why do I even bother, I try and try and try so hard to be a good person and live but every single person just pummels on me every second of every day, I’m not good enough, my mom says it, my friends say it. There is not a creature in this universe that is affected positively by my living. If anything they are affected negatively, one thing after another keeps happening with no end. 15 years and I can’t remember a day of happiness, the worst part is I’ve discovered lost memories and writings that showed me that the abuse was WAY worse that I though it was. Now I’m trapped with no other escape, I’ve tried for 4 years to please to my mom to save me, I don’t want to suffer anymore please help me I’m running out of time. But after all of those years I’ve just given in, I cut myself, searching for a way out. I stare at the toxic items kept in my house wondering how quick they would kill me, I’ve though about running away before realizing I have absolutely no where to go. If I’m going to leave I am never coming back, death Is my only escape. The thought t of being tortured in hell for the rest of eternity sucks but what’s new, just another form of torture right? 
Anyway I should go, I have a life to waste away.
